description: Two-factor authentication using OTP (One-Time Password) or HOTP (HMAC-based). Users authenticate with password + 6-digit code from authenticator app. Supporting Android applications like Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis or Android Authenticator.

parameters.usersfile: Path to users.oath file containing OTP secrets

parameter_help.usersfile: File with OTP secrets. Format: HOTP/TOTP username - SECRETKEY
parameter_help.window: Number of time windows to accept (for clock drift). window=10 allows ±10 time periods.

enrollment_workflow: 1. Administrator generates OTP secret: secret=$(head -c 20 /dev/urandom | base32)
2. Add to users.oath: echo 'HOTP username - SECRET' >> /etc/users.oath
3. User scans QR code with phone
5. User logs in with password + 6-digit code
benefits: Can authenticate from anywhere (phone has app)
limitations: User must have phone with app
recovery: Backup codes: generate during enrollment for emergency access
notes: Perfect for enterprise 2FA. Simple to manage. Most users familiar with authenticator apps.
